news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.01 loss per share (vs ₹0.02 profit in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.01 loss per share (down from ₹0.02 profit in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹34.0m (up 43% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹617.0k (down 252% from profit in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 60% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 7% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.
